content.content: When invoked as `deccy init [path]`, the deccy CLI shall create the jj workspace at `path`.
content.rationale: The invocation prepares a repository for dec-graph use (IN-verb), and the graph lives in a jj workspace (xkolyytz) — so creating that workspace is the invocation's first effect. Stating it as an end keeps the workspace the CLI's to make, not the caller's.
